summary: Security fixes retest (SEC-001/002/003) on the backend via the public URL plus a full browser flow. PASSED: 51 files -> 400 'Massimo 50 file per richiesta'; exactly 50 -> 200 with 50 results. A 101MB file plus a valid xml in the same request -> 'File troppo grande (max 100 MB)' for the big file only and the xml is imported (2.8s). 3-level ZIP nesting is imported; 4 levels -> 'Troppi archivi ZIP annidati'. A ZIP under 1MB holding a 25MB member -> 'File troppo grande (max 20 MB)' while the sibling member is imported; the backend stays responsive. 17x19MB members -> 'Archivio troppo grande: dividilo in più parti'. 5001 members -> the same error. A billion-laughs DOCTYPE/ENTITY -> 'XML non valido: dichiarazioni DTD/ENTITY non ammesse'. A UTF-16 billion-laughs gets past the byte regex, but expat 2.8.5 amplification protection rejects it (error result, no crash). CSV: '=HYPERLINK(..)', '+1+1', '@SUM(1)' and '-2+3' get an apostrophe prefix, as does a numero '-TEST_CSV4'; amounts 100,00/22,00/122,00 are unchanged and the DB value is not modified. The samples (xml, p7m, lotto.zip) import correctly. UI flow on the preview URL: login, upload of 4 files (results show the formula import, the nested-ZIP error, the DTD error and the lotto import), CSV download with the apostrophe-prefixed cell, admin company switch (to an empty company, 0 fatture), reload keeps the session, logout, and the protected route redirects to /login. FAILED: (1) a corrupt-CRC ZIP and an encrypted ZIP member -> HTTP 500. (2) The Set-Cookie seen on the public preview URL is 'SameSite=None; Partitioned'; the backend itself emits SameSite=lax (verified on :8001), so the preview ingress is rewriting the cookie.

minor.issue: zf.read(info) in fattura_parser.extract_xml_files (line 77) is not wrapped in try/except. A ZIP with a bad CRC (also a ZIP whose declared file_size is a lie -> BadZipFile 'Bad CRC-32'), an encrypted member (RuntimeError 'password required') or an unsupported compression method (NotImplementedError) raises out of the generator -> 500 for the whole request. The user loses all per-file results, while invoices from earlier members are already stored. Repro: /app/backend/tests/zip_lying_size_repro.py and the tests test_encrypted_zip_member_no_500 / test_corrupt_crc_zip_no_500.

Backend sets SameSite=lax; Secure; HttpOnly correctly, but on the preview domain the ingress rewrites it to 'SameSite=None; Partitioned'. The app is not at fault; production behaviour should be verified after deploy.

action_items: In extract_xml_files wrap zf.read(info) in try/except (zipfile.BadZipFile, RuntimeError, NotImplementedError, zlib.error, EOFError, OSError) and yield (name, None, 'File danneggiato o protetto da password nell'archivio') then continue
Optionally add a generic per-file try/except in upload_invoices so one broken file can never 500 the whole batch
critical_code_review_comments: The budget double-counts: a nested ZIP's own file_size is added to budget.total and so are its members' sizes. This is conservative and harmless, but the effective limit for nested archives is below 300MB.

The DOCTYPE regex only scans the first 4096 bytes and is byte-based (UTF-16 bypasses it). It is currently safe because expat>=2.4 has amplification limits and ET does not resolve external entities. Consider defusedxml or decoding before the check for defense in depth.
There is no total request-size cap (50 files x 100MB = 5GB spooled to disk per request). Consider an ingress/body-size limit.
The frontend Upload.jsx batches 10 files per request, so the 50-file limit never affects the UI folder upload.
